description: Checkpoint 2 Output Schema — Director / Forecast. Extends CP1 with directional predictions and grounded forecast rationale.
purpose: CP2 is the machine-checkable schema for the Director node output in the Lab pipeline, and the corresponding Oracle node output for audit. Every CP2-producing node must emit a JSON object satisfying all CP1 constraints plus the additional constraints below. Runtime ownership split: Director emits semantic fields including snapshot_value and target_value; engine injects deterministic temporal fields and audits model-emitted snapshot_value against the subject-run observation baseline. Final enriched payload is validated by system.lib.schema_validator.validate_cp2.

evidence_dictionary.constraint: Inherited from CP1. Must also satisfy CP2 grounding rules.
evidence_dictionary.semantics: Evidence set must include at least one observation-lane entry per prediction target_id for grounding. Valid grounding prefixes are S_ (measurements) or E_ (SUBSYSTEMS).

epicentre_thesis.constraint: Inherited from CP1 + epicentre_thesis semantic contract.
epicentre_thesis.semantics: Same single-dominant-force requirement as CP1. Predictions must be consequences of this thesis.

predictions_t.constraint: Non-empty. Each entry must be a valid PredictionUnit.
predictions_t.semantics: Directional predictions that are EXPLICIT CONSEQUENCES of epicentre_thesis — not independent calls. Each prediction must be explainable as a transmission consequence of the dominant force.

forecast_rationale.constraint: Word count >= forecast_rationale_base_words + forecast_rationale_per_prediction_words * len(predictions_t). Must contain only resolved [N] citations.
forecast_rationale.semantics: Narrates the force -> transmission -> prediction consequence chain. Not a list of isolated forecast ideas. Must explicitly connect each prediction back to the epicentre thesis causal mechanism.

decision_status.constraint: FORECAST (default) or ABSTAIN; unknown values rejected

abstention.constraint: Required only for ABSTAIN; forbidden in FORECAST; see decision_mode_contract

target_id.constraint: Non-empty. For observation predictions: uppercase target_id symbol.
target_id.semantics: The entity being predicted. Must exist in the T-n measurements+SUBSYSTEMS target_id universe when out-of-universe enforcement is active.

direction.semantics: Expected directional move at horizon T. Must be a consequence of the epicentre thesis transmission path.

snapshot_time.constraint: ISO 8601 datetime string. Engine-owned deterministic field; must equal runtime snapshot anchor.
snapshot_time.semantics: When the T-n snapshot was taken. Enables deterministic evaluation window.

target_time_iso.constraint: ISO 8601 datetime string. Must be after snapshot_time. Engine-owned deterministic field; must equal resolved runtime horizon target.
target_time_iso.semantics: When the prediction resolves (T). Defines the falsification window.

snapshot_value.constraint: Finite numeric baseline value captured at snapshot_time. Model-emitted and engine-audited against T-n measurements+SUBSYSTEMS feed values.
snapshot_value.semantics: Baseline for direction evaluation at target_time_iso.

target_value.constraint: Finite numeric projected value level at target_time_iso.
target_value.semantics: The projected value level by target_time_iso. Must be logically consistent with snapshot_value and direction.

invalidation.constraint: Non-empty string. Must state a specific falsifiable condition for this individual prediction target.
invalidation.semantics: Per-prediction invalidation condition. Distinct from the global thesis invalidation in forecast_rationale.

consequence_coherence.description: CP2 predictions are not independent calls. They must be explicit consequences of epicentre_thesis.
rules: epicentre_thesis declares one dominant force at T-n.
Each predictions_t[i] is explainable as a transmission consequence of that force.
forecast_rationale must narrate force -> transmission -> prediction consequence chain.
If a prediction depends on an alternative driver, that alternative must be subordinated to (or shown as derivative of) the epicentre force — not introduced as a second co-equal thesis.

grounding_rule.description: Every prediction must be grounded in explicitly sourced observation lane data.
grounding_rule.requirement: For every PredictionUnit in predictions_t, there must exist at least one evidence_dictionary entry where: subject == target_id (case-normalized .upper().strip()) AND ledger_id starts with 'S_' or 'E_'.
grounding_rule.rationale: A prediction that references only ENVIRONMENT or EVENTS evidence without a measurements/SUBSYSTEMS grounding entry is a grounding failure.

out_of_universe.description: When subject_run_dir is provided, every target_id must exist in the T-n measurements+SUBSYSTEMS target_id universe.
out_of_universe.fallback: If target_id universe cannot be loaded, MISSING_CONTEXT is emitted and OUT_OF_UNIVERSE check is skipped (degraded mode).

oracle_golden_id_guard.requirement: Every ledger_id in evidence_dictionary must exist in the T-n snapshot ledger set from the corresponding Lab run.
oracle_golden_id_guard.enforcement: validate_golden_ids(evidence_dictionary, subject_run_dir) — called from engine Oracle path, not from validate_cp2 itself.

citation_rules.description: Same rules as CP1 epicentre_thesis, applied to both epicentre_thesis and forecast_rationale.
citation_rules.valid_format: [N] where N is a positive integer
citation_rules.resolution_rule: Every [N] must resolve to an evidence_dictionary entry with matching ref_id.

validation_sequence: 1. validate_cp1(payload) — structural + citation + word-count for CP1 fields

2. Validate CP2-specific fields — predictions_t presence, direction enum, snapshot_value + target_value numeric validity, direction/target coherence, temporal fields, forecast_rationale, and engine value-audit flags
3. Grounding checks — per-prediction evidence with S_ or E_ ledger
5. [Oracle only] Golden ID guard — Phase 10, engine-level

error_codes._inherited: All CP1 error codes apply (MISSING_FIELD, INVALID_REF_ID, DUPLICATE_REF_ID, DUPLICATE_LEDGER_ID, INVALID_LEDGER_ID, MALFORMED_CITATION, CITATION_UNRESOLVED, BELOW_MIN_WORD_COUNT).
error_codes.INVALID_FIELD: A field value is present but invalid (e.g. direction not in {UP, DOWN}).
error_codes.MISSING_SNAPSHOT_VALUE: snapshot_value is missing for a prediction target.
error_codes.MISSING_TARGET_VALUE: target_value is missing for a prediction target.
error_codes.INVALID_TARGET_DIRECTION: direction and target_value are not logically consistent with snapshot_value.
error_codes.SNAPSHOT_VALUE_MISMATCH: Model-emitted snapshot_value diverges from feed baseline beyond allowed tolerance.
error_codes.TEMPORAL_ORDER_INVALID: target_time_iso is not strictly after snapshot_time.
error_codes.TEMPORAL_MISMATCH: prediction temporal fields diverge from canonical runtime values.
error_codes.GROUNDING_FAILED_WRONG_LANE: A target_id has no evidence entry with subject == target_id AND ledger_id starting with S_ or E_.
error_codes.UNGROUNDED_TARGET: A target_id is not present in the cross_corr_v2 TARGET_SWARM or SOLO_TARGET sets. Prediction was not structurally grounded by the cross-correlator.
error_codes.MISSING_CONTEXT: target_id universe could not be loaded from subject_run_dir.
error_codes.OUT_OF_UNIVERSE: A target_id is not present in the T-n target_id set.

lab_director.role: Extend locked CP1 thesis with predictions and forecast rationale.
lab_director.boundary: Must ensure predictions_t are direct consequences of epicentre_thesis, emit snapshot_value + target_value per prediction, ground targets with subject-matching measurements or SUBSYSTEMS evidence, and must NOT introduce a second co-equal thesis.

oracle_cp2_emitter.role: Emit audit-grade CP2 from T perspective with golden ID enforcement.
oracle_cp2_emitter.boundary: Same coherence requirements as lab_director, plus golden ID guard and subject-only grounding.

deferred_contracts.scorecard.md: LAYERED/DEFERRED: depends on confidence/magnitude semantics removed from v0.
deferred_contracts.counter_vector.md: Non-normative prose guide only; not validated by engine.
deferred_contracts.hypothesis_slug.md: Non-normative prose guide only; not validated by engine.

abstention.evidence_refs: Nonempty references resolving to the supplied evidence dictionary
abstention.semantics: Explain why no supported forward thesis was selected; not a successful prediction or zero loss
abstention.thesis: Keep the cited 150-word explanation in epicentre_thesis; causal dominance requirements apply only to FORECAST
abstention.cp2: predictions_t must be exactly []; forecast_rationale remains required with citations and at least 75 words
abstention.propagation: Forward Director preserves locked CP1 status. Oracle may reconsider only from genuinely available subject-side evidence.
